description: VERIFICATION TEST: Same as QuickWin Optimized BUT with FULL 710 validation to verify if PSNR 23.09 is REAL or sampling bias
_purpose: Test if PSNR improvement (+15%) is legitimate or caused by sampling bias
_question: QuickWin showed PSNR 23.09 dB (sampled 400), baseline 20.01 dB (full 710). Is PSNR improvement REAL?
_hypothesis: If PSNR drops to ~20 dB with full validation → sampling bias. If stays ~23 dB → legitimate improvement
_change_3: Keep batch_size: 4 (for speed, consistent with QuickWin)
_comment_batch_size: Keep batch_size=4 for speed (consistent with QuickWin)
_comment_eval_interval: CHANGED: Validate EVERY epoch (was 2) for detailed comparison
_comment_num_val_batches: REMOVED: Use FULL 710 validation samples (not sampled 100)
_comment_warmup: CTC active from Epoch 1 (same as QuickWin)
_slowdown: 2.4× slower than sampled validation (acceptable for verification)
_scenario_1: If PSNR ~23 dB & CER ~0.31 → QuickWin improvement LEGITIMATE
_scenario_2: If PSNR ~20 dB & CER ~0.31 → QuickWin improvement was SAMPLING BIAS
_scenario_3: If PSNR ~20 dB & CER ~0.32 → Both PSNR and CER were biased (worst case)
_quickwin_sampled: PSNR 23.09 dB, CER 0.3141 (sampled 400, bs=4) ← TO VERIFY
_criterion_1: PSNR consistency: |PSNR_full - PSNR_sampled| < 1.0 dB → sampling bias negligible
_criterion_2: CER consistency: |CER_full - CER_sampled| < 0.02 → sampling bias negligible
_criterion_3: If both consistent → QuickWin results are TRUSTWORTHY
